<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Alison has confirmed that the meeting is booked for Thursday, November 19 at 14:30. My next and final step is to send the confirmation email to all four partners.

I will use the `send_confirmation_email` function. I need to specify the day, start time, and body of the email.
- Day: "Thu"
- Start time: "14:30"
- Body: A suitable confirmation message.

I'll compose a professional email confirming the meeting details. Once I send the email, the task will be complete.All four partners are available on Thursday, November 19 at 14:30. Alison has created the booking. I will now send the confirmation email.
